cohort: The study included 1455 women experiencing spontaneous preterm labor and preterm delivery who attended 20 hospitals in Brazil.
finding: Prenatal corticosteroid use was associated with lower pneumonia and mortality rates among neonates delivered at 32-33+6 weeks, but with worse outcomes including longer hospital admission and increased morbidities in neonates delivered at 34-36+6 weeks.
gest_age: Preterm deliveries before 34 weeks and at 34-36+6 weeks of pregnancy were included, with specific analyses for 32-33+6 weeks and 34-36+6 weeks.
